notes.title: DEMO UPDATE #4 | HEAVY ATTACKS, WEAPON IMPROVEMENTS, AND MORE...
notes.notes: [p]Thank you once again for all your feedback and reports. I’m continuing to refine the game based on everything you share.[/p][p][/p][p]Here are the fixes and tweaks included in Update #4:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Patch Notes – Fixes & Improvements:[/b][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Added new charged/heavy attacks: by holding the attack button, you’ll perform a powerful strike dealing [b]50% more damage[/b] than the base damage of the equipped melee weapon.[/p][/*][*][p]Firearms now deal significantly more damage, making them far more effective than melee weapons in most situations.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced camera bob while attacking, walking, and running to make gameplay smoother and reduce visual distraction.[/p][/*][*][p]The red cross marker and collectible items on the shore will now always remain in place, even after loading from a checkpoint ensuring they no longer block the path upward.[/p][/*][*][p]Completely disabled motion blur.[/p][/*][*][p]Various smaller tweaks and optimizations to improve overall gameplay feel.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Let me know what you think and, as always, feel free to join [url="https://discord.gg/kmGZP5VATs"]Discord[/url] and share more feedback![/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/kmGZP5VATs" style="button" buttoncolor="#a80000"]JOIN DISCORD[/url][/p]

notes.title: DEMO UPDATE #3 | PERFORMANCE FIXES, ENEMY AI IMPROVEMENTS AND MORE...
notes.notes: [p][b]Thank you once again for another feedback and reports.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]I am continuing to improve the game based on everything you share.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Here are the fixes and tweaks included in Update #3:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Patch Notes – Fixes & Improvements:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Eliminated all stutters, freezes, and FPS drops that occurred when enemies spawned or during level loading and other specific situations.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved enemy AI behavior. Previously, even when standing very close, some enemies would circle around you instead of attacking... they now engage properly at close range.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies will no longer always get back up after being knocked down. Some may now stay down and die, while others will get up more slowly, giving you a better chance to finish them off.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the dynamic camera rotation when moving the mouse left and right, as it caused motion sickness for some players.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Let me know what you think and as always, feel free to join [url="https://discord.gg/kmGZP5VATs"]Discord[/url] and share more feedback![/p][p] [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/kmGZP5VATs" style="button" buttoncolor="#b80000"]JOIN DISCORD[/url][/p]

notes.title: DEMO UPDATE #2 | FIXED FACE ANIMATIONS, FIXED FINISHERS AND MORE...
notes.notes:
[p][b]Thank you again for all the incredible feedback, here’s what’s new in Update #2![/b]
[/p][p]Every small bug report helps make the game better. I’ve been working hard behind the scenes to fix what I can as quickly as possible, and here’s what changed:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Patch Notes – Fixes & Improvements:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Finally found a way to fix the strange facial animations during cutscenes. Characters should now look much more natural and less... terrifying (unless intended).[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45664666/90578e6f8641d1cb0764108d29538b8684a998e8.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where performing finishers could sometimes lock the player in place and freeze movement.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved collision in multiple areas to reduce stuck spots and strange movement glitches.[/p][/*][*][p]Various smaller tweaks and polish to help make gameplay feel smoother overall.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Still more to come and if you spot anything else or have thoughts, hop on our [url="https://discord.gg/kmGZP5VATs"]Discord[/url] and let me know![/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/kmGZP5VATs" style="button" buttoncolor="#a30000"]JOIN DISCORD[/url][/p]

notes.title: DEMO UPDATE #1 | PICK UP DROPPED ITEMS, IMPROVED NOTES AND MORE...
notes.notes: [p][b]Thank you so much to everyone who played the demo and shared feedback — it truly means a lot.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]This is just the beginning of many improvements to come, so if you have more thoughts or suggestions, feel free to join our [url="https://discord.gg/kmGZP5VATs"]Discord[/url] and let me know![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Patch Notes – Fixes & Improvements:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added a small “plus” icon to the items that can be combined together.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where falling rock debris would endlessly respawn at the beginning of the level.[/p][/*][*][p]Made notes closing animations faster and added a warning icon to the notes pickups to prevent confusion with key items during combat.[/p][/*][*][p]Dropped items now fall to the ground instead of disappearing and can be picked up again.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/kmGZP5VATs" style="button" buttoncolor="#ad0000"]JOIN DISCORD[/url][/p]
